observations: Photo 0: A large solar panel with a white frame and black photovoltaic cells arranged in a grid. The panel is standing upright in a cluttered indoor space. A person in a red-and-white checkered shirt is visible at the bottom right, bending over a green sack.
Photo 1: Same panel from a slightly different angle, showing the same grid of cells and white frame. The watermark 'NETWORK SOLAR VENTURES' is visible. The panel appears to be new or lightly used.
Photo 2: The back of the panel, showing a white surface with two black connectors (likely for wiring) and a small label or sticker near the center. The watermark is present.
Photo 3: The back of the panel from a frontal view, showing the same connectors and label. The panel is leaning against a wall. The watermark is again visible.
All photos have a timestamp '2025/08/07 14:54' and location 'Lagos, Nigeria'.
The panel appears to be a standard monocrystalline or polycrystalline solar panel, but no brand or model is visible on the front or back.
The panel is not labeled with any specifications (wattage, voltage, etc.) in the photos.
The surface of the panel is glossy, with reflections and some smudges, suggesting it may be new or lightly used.
